content: 2025 reusable-library baseline: ruff for both lint and format (replaces flake8+black+isort), configured via [tool.ruff] in pyproject.toml with rule sets E/W/F/I/UP/B/C4/SIM/RUF; mypy (or pyright) in strict-ish mode for a public API library since type accuracy matters for consumers; pre-commit with astral-sh/ruff-pre-commit (ruff-check --fix, ruff-format) plus pre-commit/mirrors-mypy. This is the dominant modern pattern replacing the old black+isort+flake8+pylint stack.
